question: schools under-delivering on applications - received less than 50 percent of what was expected, loose name matching (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
gold_sql: WITH best AS (SELECT a."Applicant" AS applicant, o."School Name" AS matched_school, jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) AS sim FROM lpf_applications AS a JOIN lpf_outreach AS o ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY sim DESC, o."School Name") = 1) SELECT o."School Name", COUNT(b.applicant) AS applications_received, o."Applications Expected" FROM lpf_outreach AS o LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.matched_school = o."School Name" GROUP BY o."School Name", o."Applications Expected" HAVING COUNT(b.applicant) < o."Applications Expected" / 2.0 ORDER BY o."School Name"

WITH matched_outreach AS (
  SELECT 
    o."School Name" AS school_name,
    o."Students Reached",
    o."Applications Expected",
    o."Block",
    o."Contact Teacher",
    o."Date"
  FROM "lpf_outreach" o
),
matched_applications AS (
  SELECT 
    a."Applicant",
    a."School" AS school_name,
    a."Course",
    a."Status",
    a."Marks",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(m."School Name"))) DESC) AS rn
  FROM "lpf_applications" a
  LEFT JOIN matched_outreach m ON TRUE
  WHERE jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(m."School Name"))) >= 0.9
),
best_matches AS (
  SELECT 
    "Applicant",
    "School" AS school_name,
    "Course",
    "Status",
    "Marks"
  FROM matched_applications
  WHERE rn = 1
),
school_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    bm.school_name,
    COUNT(*) AS actual_applications
  FROM best_matches bm
  GROUP BY bm.school_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    mo.school_name,
    mo."Students Reached",
    mo."Applications Expected",
    COALESCE(sc.actual_applications, 0) AS actual_applications
  FROM matched_outreach mo
  LEFT JOIN school_counts sc ON mo.school_name = sc.school_name
)
SELECT 
  "School Name",
  "Students Reached",
  "Applications Expected",
  actual_applications,
  CASE 
    WHEN "Applications Expected" = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (actual_applications * 100.0) / "Applications Expected"
  END AS percent_of_expected
FROM combined
WHERE "Applications Expected" > 0
  AND actual_applications < ("Applications Expected" * 0.5)
ORDER BY "School Name";
